portable.title: Portable EV Charger
portable.tagline: Charge anywhere — home, office, or on the road
portable.description: The DESIREFIT Portable EV Charger is your go-anywhere charging companion. Lightweight and compact, it plugs into any standard household socket and delivers reliable Level 1 charging wherever you are — no installation required.

highlights.label: Plug & Play
highlights.detail: No installation needed — plugs into any standard 16A socket

highlights.label: Lightweight
highlights.detail: Under 2 kg — fits in your boot or travel bag with ease

highlights.label: Universal Fit
highlights.detail: Compatible with all Type 2 EVs and PHEVs

highlights.label: Safety First
highlights.detail: Built-in over-temperature, over-current, and earth fault protection
